cards.answer: Anivia is a mage who controls space with a movement-blocking wall and a damaging, slowing storm. Her spells deal magic damage and scale with AP.
cards.counterplay: Avoid fighting inside her storm, and watch for walls that cut off your path.

citations.quote: Name: Anivia. Official role tags: Mage.
Active: Anivia erects a wall of ice that lingers for a few seconds, blocking movement.
Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail to damage her enemies and slow their advance.

facts.claim: Anivia is a mage who controls space with a movement-blocking wall and a damaging, slowing storm.

citations.quote: Magic Damage per Tick:15 / 22.5 / 30 (+ 6.25% AP)

facts.claim: Her spells deal magic damage and scale with AP.

cards.priority_reason: Recognizing her area control helps explain where she threatens enemies in fights.
uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft. AP is a broad learning focus, not an optimal item build.

cards.answer: When Rebirth is available, fatal damage turns Anivia into an egg. She revives if the egg survives for a few seconds.
cards.counterplay: If it is safe, attack the egg before she revives.

citations.quote: Innate: Periodically, upon dying, Anivia will instead revert into an egg.
Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg and is reborn with full health.

facts.claim: When Rebirth is available, fatal damage turns Anivia into an egg.

citations.quote: If the egg can survive for a few seconds, she is gloriously reborn.

facts.claim: She revives if the egg survives for a few seconds.

passive_visual.description: Anivia becomes an egg after fatal damage, then returns to bird form if the egg survives.

cards.priority_reason: Her egg can prevent a kill from ending the fight against her.
uncertainties: The visible cue is a tentative proposal supported by the supplied demonstration frames, not current-client visual verification.
Riot and Wiki differ in precision about health restoration timing; full health upon completed revival is not consistently established.
Resurrection defense modifiers vary with level and are not always positive. Tether, revival-priority and channel interactions are omitted advanced details.

cards.answer: Anivia launches an ice projectile that damages and slows enemies along its path. Its explosion damages and stuns nearby enemies. She can recast during flight to explode it early; otherwise, it explodes at maximum range.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the projectile and keep clear of its explosion area.

citations.quote: Active: Anivia launches a chunk of ice that deals magic damage and slows enemies hit.
Anivia brings her wings together and summons a sphere of ice that flies towards her opponents, chilling and damaging anyone in its path.

facts.claim: Anivia launches an ice projectile that damages and slows enemies along its path.

citations.quote: When the sphere explodes it does moderate damage in a radius, stunning anyone in the area.
Recast: The ice explodes, dealing magic damage and stunning nearby enemies.

facts.claim: Its explosion damages and stuns nearby enemies.

citations.quote: Flash Frost can be recast while the ice is in flight after its cast time, and does so automatically at maximum range.

facts.claim: She can recast during flight to explode it early; otherwise, it explodes at maximum range.

cards.priority_reason: The explosion's stun can set up follow-up damage or stop an enemy's advance.
uncertainties: The initial pass does not itself stun. A spell shield blocking the initial pass does not also block the explosion.

cards.answer: Anivia creates a temporary ice wall that blocks movement through its terrain. The wall melts after a short time.
cards.counterplay: Keep an alternate route open and move around the wall when it blocks your path.

citations.quote: Active: Anivia erects a wall of ice that lingers for a few seconds, blocking movement.
The wall lingers as impassable terrain for 5 seconds.

facts.claim: Anivia creates a temporary ice wall that blocks movement through its terrain.

citations.quote: The wall only lasts a short duration before it melts.

facts.claim: The wall melts after a short time.

cards.priority_reason: Blocking a route can split enemies or cut off an escape.
uncertainties: Movement blocking describes terrain; the evidence does not establish that every dash or blink is prevented from crossing.
Placement displacement and its combat interactions are omitted advanced details. Knockback speed is explicitly pending testing.
The wall does not block sight; projectile blocking is unsupported.

cards.answer: Anivia deals magic damage to a targeted enemy. The damage doubles if the enemy was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm.
cards.counterplay: Dodge Flash Frost and leave Glacial Storm before it fully forms to avoid setting up double damage.

citations.quote: Active: Anivia blasts a freezing wind at the target enemy that deals magic damage.

facts.claim: Anivia deals magic damage to a targeted enemy.

citations.quote: If the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm, the damage they take is doubled.
Active: Anivia blasts a freezing wind at the target enemy that deals magic damage, doubled if they were Iced.
Passive: Enemies hit by Flash Frost or a fully formed Glacial Storm become Iced for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.

facts.claim: The damage doubles if the enemy was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm.

cards.priority_reason: Recognizing the setup helps explain a major increase in her damage threat.
uncertainties: The qualifying mark must remain active at impact; casting while marked does not guarantee double damage.
The Wiki's shorter summary omits the fully formed storm condition; Riot and the detailed Wiki mechanics agree on that requirement.
Target invalidation during cast time has cancellation exceptions omitted from this beginner explanation.

cards.answer: Anivia toggles a persistent storm at a chosen location that repeatedly damages and slows enemies inside. The storm grows after activation, dealing more damage and applying a stronger slow at full size.
cards.counterplay: Leave the storm promptly and avoid fighting inside it as it grows.

citations.quote: Toggle: Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail at the target location that continually deals magic damage and slows enemies within.
Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail to damage her enemies and slow their advance.

facts.claim: Anivia toggles a persistent storm at a chosen location that repeatedly damages and slows enemies inside.

citations.quote: The blizzard increases in size over 1.5 seconds. At maximum size, Glacial Storm is empowered to deal 300% damage and increase the effectiveness of its slow by 50%

facts.claim: The storm grows after activation, dealing more damage and applying a stronger slow at full size.

cards.priority_reason: Its growing damage and slow make remaining in the area increasingly dangerous.
uncertainties: Persistence is conditional: excessive distance, insufficient mana or cast-inhibiting crowd control ends the storm.
The Wiki's short summary is broader than its detailed interruption rules. Zhonya's stasis preserves the storm, while allied or enemy Devour interrupts it.
Flash Frost slow enhancement, the final damage tick and the visible slow trail are omitted advanced details; the trail does not establish true sight.

conflicts.resolution: Explain egg survival and revival without guaranteeing full health on completion.
Retain the fully formed Glacial Storm requirement shared by Riot and the detailed Wiki text.
Use the detailed distance and cast-inhibiting crowd-control rules for QA; do not claim Anivia must stand inside the storm or that every disable interrupts it.
conflicts.topic: Glacial Storm maintenance and interruption summary

cooldown_candidates.reason: The stun's availability strongly affects her ability to stop enemies and set up damage.
Wall availability affects whether she can block an approach or escape route.
Repeated targeted damage matters after a qualifying hit sets up the bonus.
Turning the storm off or having it interrupted affects when she can establish the area again.

factual_risks: All six cards are UNAPPROVED drafts.
